expected_symptom: dxc fails internally (assert / access violation / llvm_unreachable / bad cast) compiling an as_6_5 shader that copies a cbuffer-backed struct wholesale into a DispatchMesh payload; a well-formed diagnostic is not the symptom
history: always-repro'd -- all 19 probeable releases v1.5.2010..v1.9.2607 fail; v1.4.1907 predates as_6_5 and never ran the repro (invalid-probe, confirmed with a feature-presence control). v1.5.2010 is 3 weeks older than the report, so this covers the issue's whole life. NOT an NDEBUG artefact: with the assert compiled out the leftover memcpy's operand is deleted anyway and release builds access-violate.
summary: Still asserts on Debug main (13730886e): DXASSERT(0, 'not implemented yet') at lib/HLSL/HLOperationLower.cpp:8801 in TranslateCBAddressUserLegacy, exit 0x80000003. Reported mechanism is unchanged -- 'p.lhSampleData = g_lhSampleData' becomes one llvm.memcpy out of the legacy cbuffer, whose HLOpcodeGroup is NotHL, and the cbuffer-user walker has no case for it. Only the line moved: 6207 was the CallInst arm's final else; PR #3034 (eaa7f95d0, 6 days after filing) inserted an IntrinsicInst branch, so memcpy now hits its inner else at 8801 (outer one is 8804, identical text). Reached from DxilGenerationPass::GenerateDxilOperations -> TranslateHLSubscript(CBufferSubscript) -> TranslateCBOperationsLegacy. Not $Globals-specific (an explicit cbuffer block traps too) and not payload-agnostic (the same copy into an RWStructuredBuffer in cs_6_0 compiles clean) -- the DispatchMesh payload is what keeps the copy a memcpy into DXIL lowering. Field-by-field copy compiles clean on main and back to v1.5.2010, and is a workaround. All 19 probeable releases fail, in 4 different shapes: access violation 0xC0000005 (9, one of them with completely empty output), DXC_E_LLVM_UNREACHABLE 0x80AA001C DataLayout::getTypeSizeInBits (2), E_FAIL 0x80004005 with UNREACHABLE executed (7), E_FAIL with llvm::cast<X>() argument of incompatible type (1) -- so 8 of 19 exit with the same status as a syntax error and a message-keyed predicate would have reported this as fixed.
title: Missing implementation for HLOpcodeGroup::NotHL in TranslateCBAddressUserLegacy
